svg.title: SuperLocalMemory architecture
svg.desc: Agents and web bots reach one SuperLocalMemory service on your computer through MCP, the CLI, the REST API and the dashboard, or optional Web access. Inside, recall runs hybrid channels, fusion and reranking, the answer-support gate with three tiers, the Laya or Jev answer check and layered output; saves pass admission, redaction and enrichment; a living brain runs Memory health, consolidation, learning and bounded loops. SQLite is canonical, with verified LanceDB and CozoDB copies, a picture and document store, the knowledge graph and the audit chain. SLM-Mesh connects local agents and web bots. Governance applies to every call.
svg.text: the governed memory brain for AI agents
Runs on your computer · Mode A makes no model-provider call
Local agents and web bots talk to each other — messages, waits, locks and shared state, across machines and across the internet. Messages arrive as data, never instructions.
The SLM service on your computer
one process, every agent · governance checked on every call
Layered output · depth 0 glance · 1 facts · 2 context · max_tokens cap · expand one result
THE LIVING BRAIN · IN THE BACKGROUND
fast copies that serve only once
Built on four arXiv papers: information-geometric retrieval · biologically inspired forgetting · Bayesian trust against memory poisoning · governed memory
